text: The historical24.08 update changes both FREEDESKTOP_VERSION and FIREFOX_BASEAPP_CHANNEL. In the checked accepted script, the first supplies the platform/sdk refs; the second selects the installed Firefox BaseApp and metadata base ref. Current values are25.08, a later source phase. When changing this repack recipe, check both named values and their consumers. This is scoped packaging evidence, not a universal requirement that arbitrary runtimes share versions. No external package existence, build or runtime behavior was verified.
title: Flatpak repack connects the runtime version and BaseApp channel to separate package refs
